description: This file defines an abstract class 'BrowserType' for managing browser launching, connection, and process handling within the Playwright project. It includes methods for launching browsers, handling processes, and managing transport connections, with specific hooks for different browser implementations.

classes.name: BrowserType
classes.description: An abstract class representing a browser type, providing methods for launching, connecting, and managing browser processes and transports.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Returns the executable path for the browser type.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the browser type.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a browser instance with specified options.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Launches a persistent browser context with specified options.

methods.name: _innerLaunchWithRetries
methods.description: Retries launching the browser in case of specific errors.

methods.name: _innerLaunch
methods.description: Handles the core logic of launching a browser process and establishing transport.

methods.name: _prepareToLaunch
methods.description: Prepares arguments and directories for launching the browser.

methods.name: _launchProcess
methods.description: Starts the browser process and manages its lifecycle.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to a browser over Chrome DevTools Protocol (not supported for non-Chromium).

methods.name: connectOverCDPTransport
methods.description: Connects to a browser over a transport (not supported for non-Chromium).

methods.name: _launchWithSeleniumHub
methods.description: Launches a browser via Selenium Hub (not supported for non-Chromium).

methods.name: _validateLaunchOptions
methods.description: Validates and adjusts launch options.

methods.name: _createUserDataDirArgMisuseError
methods.description: Creates an error message for incorrect userDataDir argument usage based on SDK language.

methods.name: _rewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites protocol error logs for better readability.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready.

methods.name: prepareUserDataDir
methods.description: Prepares the user data directory.

methods.name: supportsPipeTransport
methods.description: Indicates if pipe transport is supported.

methods.name: getExecutableName
methods.description: Returns the executable name based on options.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Abstract method to get default launch arguments.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Abstract method to connect to a transport.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Abstract method to amend environment variables for launch.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Abstract method to rewrite startup logs.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Abstract method to attempt graceful closure of the browser.
